hardware_from_phase05.conditions: Downloads and builds completed; no model process running during the final bandwidth probe. Clean inference uses one locked runner, fresh CLI processes, alternating CPU/Metal, three trials each, no warm-up. OS page cache and Metal shader caches were warmed by preliminary attempts; no purge or system setting change. Other user workloads are not controlled.
hardware_from_phase05.thermal_state_note: ProcessInfo.thermalState: 0=nominal; recorded after the model runs and before/after the separate final bandwidth probe. Per-CLI-trial temperatures were not sampled.

ttft_definition: server prompt_ms, matching reference; not streaming client TTFT
rss_definition: 0.5s ps process-tree RSS samples per request plus time -l per-session maximum; mapped pages included
nonce: paired between MTP off/on, unique across cells/rounds/reps
deviations: Apple Metal, all model layers offloaded, explicit PLE CPU lazy mmap
ignore_eos to force 256 measured tokens, original requests used maximum 256
paired nonce instead of config-dependent nonce
0.5s Darwin RSS sampling; no NVIDIA whole-card counter
